sam: quick flag from access hygiene sweep: our weekly rbac-scan found ~12 admin bindings across three projects where owner_email is null in the attestation db. two are service principals used by batch jobs.
nirav: can you paste the scan output or gist? want to see project names and roles.
sam: pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/def456 (redacted). snippet: ```json
[
  {
    \"project\": \"prod-ingest\",
    \"member\": \"serviceAccount:svc-batch@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",
    \"role\": \"roles/editor\",
    \"last_attested\": null
  },
  {
    \"project\": \"prod-billing\",
    \"member\": \"user:ops-automation@redwood.com\",
    \"role\": \"roles/owner\",
    \"last_attested\": \"2023-02-01\"
  }
]
```
sec-bot: DETECT: STALE_ATTestation (rule=attest-null-7) - 12 bindings flagged in last 7d. See /security/hygiene for details.
emily: heads-up — prod-billing owner is a rotation account, should have evidence but maybe attestation failed. i'll check attestation logs.
tony: operational note: for service accounts used by cron/batch, we prefer least-priv by default. we can map to roles/viewer + granular iam permissions. do we have a list of CI jobs referencing these svcaccts?
nirav: i can run a last-used query: ```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-batch@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=prod-ingest || true
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svc-batch@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"' --freshness=90d --format='value(timestamp)'
```
sam: please do. if last-used > 90d and no owner, we should schedule demotion. if last-used <=7d, notify owner and require attestation within 48h.
oncall: suggested emergency flow: if any activity after demotion attempt, oncall will immediately revoke keys and open incident. ping before any binding changes.
emily: attestation logs show prod-billing rotation job failed to update owner snapshot due to a webhook error on 2024-01-12. raising infra ticket.
iranav: small correction: nirav* (typo).
nirav: no worries. i ran last-used for svc-batch — last auth event 2024-08-10. that's recent. mark as in-use; we need owner evidence though. i'll reach out to app team.
sam: propose temporary policy: 1) OWNERLESS_WITH_RECENT_USE -> notify owners + 72h attestation SLA 2) OWNERLESS_STALE (>90d) -> apply reduce-to-view policy with TTL 7d, notify, then auto-remove if no response in 7d 3) CROSS_ACCOUNT_GRANTS -> immediate freeze + sec-triage review.
tonky: +1 on the policy, call it \"demote-first\". add a step to snapshot IAM bindings and export for postmortem.
oncall: ack. please include alerting rule so demotion events create a PagerDuty signal (low severity) and an audit log.
emily: i'll open ticket SEC-2025-112 and attach the attestation slice and proposed playbook.
sam: adding assignees: @nirav, @emily, @ops-east. will run the first sweep by EOW and report back.
sec-bot: NOTE: ticket SEC-2025-112 created and linked to hygiene-scan-1766004321 by emily.
